lines.en: I skim the edge of the mist.

lines.zh: 我的身体像被拉长了一样
lines.en: My body moves as if stretched.
I circle toward your rear flank.

lines.zh: 脚下没有真正踩到东西
lines.en: My feet never quite touch anything.

lines.zh: 成群骚扰，一点声音都没有。
lines.en: We harry in packs without a sound.
We fan out as we move.
I pass outside your sight.
My shadow falls the wrong way.

lines.zh: 空气在我身边裂开一条缝
lines.en: The air splits a seam around me.
I head toward whatever is warm.
I shift a long way in one move.
The mist hides me.
I circle you without closing in.
My outline is not quite steady.
I stop in the middle of the mist.
My shape flickers in and out.
I wait for the others to take position.
The light is eaten here.
The air trembles slightly.
We say nothing to each other.
I count the steps between us.
I can feel your warmth.
The mist gathers toward me.
I rotate very slightly.

lines.zh: 我朝着你，虽然你未必看得清
lines.en: I face you, though you may not see clearly.
The mist around you has thickened.
There is more than one of us.
Your warmth stands out in the mist.
I raise a hand with no shape.
Do not turn your head.
What you hear is only wind.
I am closer than I appear.
You have tightened your grip.
We like our prey in groups.
My shape has been broken apart.
I gather myself again.
That made me pull back.
Part of the mist is gone.
My edges are trembling.
We put some distance between us.
I feel no pain, only thinning.
You struck one of us.
It will slowly return.
We will remember that.
That warmth is bright.

lines.zh: 我们成群绕着，你打不完。
lines.en: We circle in a swarm; you cannot kill us all.
All of us caught it.
Not enough to share among us.
I shoot fast and arrive fast.
It moves in your hand.
I wait for it to cool.
This smell is rare.
We have come a little closer.
Do not put it away.
You struck only emptiness.

lines.zh: 你挥过的地方我重新长好。
lines.en: Where you swing, I grow back.

lines.zh: 这一下没碰到实在的东西
lines.en: That blow hit nothing solid.
Your hand passed through the mist.
We were briefly dispersed.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，形状晃了晃
lines.en: I pull back; my shape wavers.
You are standing among us.
We close in again.
Do not swing so wildly.
That will only tire you.

lines.zh: 你从我们中间穿过去了
lines.en: You passed right through us.

lines.zh: 我们的影子绕着你合拢
lines.en: Our shadows close around you.

lines.zh: 我们这种东西不太谈这个
lines.en: Creatures like us rarely speak of this.
But there are many of us.

lines.zh: 我可以在你身边留久一点
lines.en: I can stay near you a little longer.
If we do not come too close, we will not fray.
The mist will always be here.
We take turns watching you.
Even this counts as company.

lines.zh: 我们成群的时候才安静。
lines.en: We are quiet only in a swarm.
We will not all come near at once.
Just stay inside the mist.
I touch it, and it changes.
This goes cold in my grasp.
I do not know how to hold it.
It fell, silently.
I try to grasp it.
Void dust leaks through my fingers.
This is of no use to us.

lines.zh: 我把那点尘推到你脚边。
lines.en: I push the dust to your feet.
This is somewhat interesting.
Leave it there for now.
We all saw you together.
Your warmth is enough now.
We begin to close in.

lines.zh: 空气在我要过的地方裂开。
lines.en: The air splits where I will pass.
That sound just now was me.
The fog hides us; listen to the breathing.
We are on all four sides.
You cannot see all of us even turning.
This one comes from behind.
You cannot count us.
The mist will hide us.
My shadow splits into three.
Do not stay where you are.
Those are the easiest prey.
We have come.

lines.zh: 我们散开又聚在你周围
lines.en: We scatter and gather around you.
We follow you.
Wherever you go, the mist follows.
We take turns closing in.
The one you strike will scatter.
And it will come back.
You will hear no footsteps.
Our sounds are elsewhere.
You are running for thinner mist.
Someone is waiting there too.
Your weapon is growing heavier.

lines.zh: 我的刺尖对准你的喉咙。
lines.en: My barb points at your throat.
We are very patient.
This mist is ours.
A few steps more and you reach the edge.
There is no dark left to hide in.
We are closing the ring.
This instant before my eyes.
Your warmth is finally ours.
Only the last one remains.
Do not waste your strength.
I thrust out of the mist.
You are cut open.
The cut is thin, but not shallow.
After one thrust I fall back.
You cannot catch any of us.
I dart past your left.
Your armour cannot hold back mist.
The wound stays cold.
We have swapped positions.
You turned too late.
My shape has restored itself.
Then add one more.
Your arm is growing heavy.

lines.zh: 我的刺只划破你的袖子。
lines.en: My barb only tears your sleeve.
We come from two directions at once.
Your clothes are cut open.
We withdraw into the mist again.
This one missed; the next will not.

lines.zh: 我的第二刺比第一刺快。
lines.en: My second thrust is faster than the first.
And we are not tired at all.
The mist thickens first.
I take shape out of the mist.
More than one shape.
We stand in different directions.
A thin seam opens in the air.
You heard nothing.
We begin to spread out.

lines.zh: 这一片雾是我们带来的
lines.en: We brought this mist.
The light you hold is too bright.
The temperature is dropping.
Whatever you do, do not stop.
We have plenty of patience.
Fire burns a gap in the mist.
I scattered as I fell.
Water presses me solid.
The blast blows the mist apart.

lines.zh: 那东西穿过去，留下一个洞
lines.en: It passed through, leaving a hole.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我们的形状定住
lines.en: That force pins our shapes.

lines.zh: 我们已经很久没有吃饱
lines.en: We have not fed well in a long time.

lines.zh: 雷把雾照亮了，我们很痛
lines.en: Lightning lights the mist; it hurts us.

lines.zh: 这里和我们的家差不多
lines.en: This is much like home.
